Downloads straddled 2026-11-07 23:59 and 2026-11-08 00:00 UTC; the reading finished on 2026-11-08. For the S7 cases (read 2026-11-08): dirc.xml, drich.xml and tof_barrel.xml in full, optical_materials.xml at the QuartzOptical and Aerogel_DRICH definitions and the aerogel RINDEX table, definitions_craterlake.xml at the TOF block, definitions.xml at the PID region constants, DRICH_geo.cpp at the vessel and sector construction.

These are inputs to the DD4hep/Geant4 simulation, not outputs of it.

The staggered readout class CartesianGridXYStaggered was not read, so the exact cell positions per layer are not verified.
